name: Movement USDCx
oneLiner: USDCx is Movement's native USDC-backed dollar issued 1:1 via Circle's xReserve smart contract, with CCTP/Gateway transfers to and from USDC on other chains.
collateral: 1:1 USDC held in a Circle-deployed xReserve smart contract; the underlying reserve is Circle USDC, whose backing is short-duration U.S. Treasuries and cash held by regulated custodians.
pegMechanism: Users mint USDCx on Movement by depositing USDC into Circle's xReserve smart contract, which issues USDCx 1:1; redemption burns USDCx and releases the underlying USDC back to the user. xReserve also enables 1:1 transfers between USDCx and USDC across supported chains via Circle CCTP and Gateway without third-party bridges.

reserves.name: Circle USDC held in xReserve smart contract

mintAuthority.summary: USDCx is Movement's USDC representation issued 1:1 through Circle's xReserve contract; each USDCx is backed by locked Circle USDC and supply only changes against USDC deposits/redemptions via CCTP/Gateway, so it inherits USDC's issuer-direct mint authority.

controls.label: Circle xReserve mint/redeem wrapper (USDCx 1:1 against locked USDC)
controls.evidence: Users mint USDCx on Movement by depositing USDC into Circle's xReserve contract (1:1) and redeem by burning USDCx to release the locked USDC; xReserve also moves 1:1 between USDCx and USDC across chains via Circle CCTP and Gateway. This is a Circle-operated bridge/lockbox mint over USDC, not an independent issuer of base USDC supply.

controls.label: Inherited Circle USDC issuer mint authority
controls.evidence: Underlying USDC is issuer-minted by Circle (Ethereum MasterMinter + token owner/admin). USDCx's value and supply derive from USDC locked in xReserve, so it inherits USDC's concentrated-admin issuer posture.

review.evidence: USDCx is Movement's native USDC-backed dollar issued 1:1 via Circle's xReserve contract, with CCTP/Gateway transfers to/from USDC on other chains (reserves 100% USDC, depType wrapper, coinId usdc-circle). It is a Circle-operated bridge/lockbox wrapper rather than a new issuer, so it inherits USDC's issuer-direct mint path and concentrated-admin posture. inheritedFrom set to usdc-circle (coin has no variantOf field).
review.sourceFreeRationale: USDCx classified as a Circle xReserve USDC representation per Movement/Circle materials; posture mirrored from the parent USDC mintAuthority. The xReserve contract's on-chain admin on Movement was not independently resolved.
unresolvedQuestions: Resolve the on-chain admin/upgrade controls of Circle's xReserve contract on Movement and confirm the CCTP/Gateway lockbox cannot mint USDCx beyond locked USDC.
